name: Christopher Kirschgens
short_quote: I was surprised how well I felt after each workout - exhausted, but happy and full of power... Since the workouts with Flédéric I've never had problems with the intervertebral discs and joints any longer.
full_story: My name is Christopher Kirschgens. I am 35 years old and an avid athlete. In my youth I played a lot of handball and football, including in handball in a team of the Rhineland. Professionally, I had to give up the two team sports and look for another hobby. I started running, swimming and cycling and added weight training. Among other things in the following years, I took part in several obstacle courses (Tough Mudder or Strongman Run). For me, my first marathon in Zurich with my wife Alexandra was probably the most beautiful sporty success of my athlete's existence. I then ran two more marathons, Berlin 2017 and Freiburg i. B. 2018. Currently, my sport is limited to fitness training.

At the end of 2018 Flédéric spoke to me in the gym, he suggested to train me physically and physically healthier and to provide me with his training and his concept. 'Christopher', he said, 'if you work out with me, I'll take you up to the top.' Flédéric talked to me about weight training and health and told me that he had seen me in the gym for a long time and followed my training. He gave me a detailed idea of his concept and made me understand why it is so important to train so that I still have profit of it in old age. It is not important that you put a lot of weight on the equipment and train, it is more important that you perform exercises for everyday life which help to prevent injuries or senile deficiency. Flédéric also gave me a nutrition plan for the upcoming weeks. Important in his concept is that you should separate from the bad energy the bad feeling in your body. It should be transported away from the inside of the body to the outside away from yourself. The training should also prevent illness or, after a serious illness, lead back to positive energy and health.

In the upcoming days Flédéric developed a training concept especially for me and my needs. It should be noted that I work professionally at the German Customs and carry about 8 kg of personal equipment with me on the body (personal ballistic vest, firearm and use various operating resources). Of course, this weight has a negative effect on my bones and joints; e.g. the knee joint, spine, hip bone joints, intervertebral discs.

Flédéric started the warm-up program with me and explained to me exactly why we warm up just like that. The warm-up program lasts approx. 20 up to max. 30min. Then it was time for different exercises... We did this four times a week; once a week he did a very special training with me where I had to give full throttle. Each workout, however, was max 1 hour. Then he sent me to take a shower and I felt really fresh and powerful. I never felt bad and leached out neither had pain or tension. I was really curious about what he was teaching me in the next training session.

Flédéric tunes the training specifically for its participants. It brings you very fast forward and you notice the muscle growth. I did exercises that I haven't known before. Besides that, new exercises were added over and over again. Flédéric is right there for you and motivates you during the training. It was really great fun which is very important as well. On the one hand the training pushed you out of the comfort zone to bring you further. On the other hand the training with Flédéric made you feel being in good hands. I was surprised how well I felt after each workout - exhausted, but happy and full of power; I've never had any pain. Since the workouts with Flédéric I've never had problems with the intervertebral discs and joints as described above any longer.
To sum it up: I can 100% recommend Flédéric's concept and training.

name: Geneviève Jelsch
role: Breast cancer, fibromyalgia and Lyme disease
short_quote: I rapidly started feeling better and feeling myself coming back to life. I was full of energy again and I felt like I could climb mountains... As of today, I still exercise and I live a normal life.
full_story: Let me introduce myself. I am Geneviève. I was born in Alsace, in France, in 1962. In 2009, I started feeling pain in my joints and as the years went by, the pain became unbearable. I would scream at night because of severe pain occurring for no reason and I would scare my husband in the meantime. It was extremely violent. Words can't express the pain I underwent. I didn't understand what was happening. The doctors had no concrete answer either. All they said was it was probably a result of my former breast cancer. I had to decrease my working hours and eventually stopped working as I could hardly walk.
A few years later, my GP finally diagnosed a fibromyalgia and on top of that, the Lyme disease! I was then hospitalized because of a facial palsy which caused me to stutter for more than a year.

At that moment, I met Flédéric Payet through a friend of mine who was already part of his program. I started training with him and changing my diet. I rapidly started feeling better and feeling myself coming back to life. I was full of energy again and I felt like I could climb mountains. My husband couldn't believe his eyes!! He was very surprised to witness the significant positive changes after many years of agony. None of my siblings and friends recognized me either. I was not the same person anymore. It changed my life. I even started working again!!

I followed Flédéric's program for 2 years, including 5 training days a week in his care. As of today, I still exercise and I live a normal life. I cannot thank Flédéric enough for all that he has done for me, including comforting and supporting me during times of discouragement. He never hesitated to come and visit me at my place in times of need. I will be forever grateful to him.

name: Julia Eichmann
role: Depressed and aiming at physical performance
short_quote: During one of the most difficult times of my life, his training was the only thing that kept me going and made me get up in the morning... With him I achieved amazing results in short time.
full_story: When I met Flé for the first time, I saw a group of people running around the gym and he was yelling 'allez allez'. It didn't look like your average gym session but everyone looked so happy afterwards! I decided to talk to him and will forever be grateful that I did!

With Flé I did not only learn about sport and workouts and health but also how to push my boundaries and some important lessons for life. During one of the most difficult times of my life, his training was the only thing that kept me going and made me get up in the morning.

I don't know where I would be today, if not for him. I cannot express how grateful I am that we met. With him I achieved amazing results in short time and learned how to keep up the level by myself after I moved away and didn't have him as a coach anymore.
It was also astonishing to watch the transformation of other people in the gym. Witnessing how people who could barely walk started to run and push weights.
I can only recommend everyone to meet Flé as a coach and as a person - it will change your life forever!

name: Juan Carlos Carignani
short_quote: Thanks to Flédéric's training... I achieved a very good overall fitness. The results during the race was beyond expectations in the sense that I could remain strong and capable of facing harsh conditions.
full_story: Hello, my name is Juan Carlos Carignani, I am a Rally Dakar competitor and I would like to give some feedback about the training I have been doing with Flédéric.

The Rally Dakar is the hardest, biggest and longest Rally of the world, in which the participants face many dangerous situations and are exposed to two weeks of extreme efforts requiring endurance. In addition, there are many complications which require you must be mentally and physically prepared if you want to get through the whole Rally race.

Thanks to Flédéric's training, in which he prepared me with effective exercises, I achieved a very good overall fitness. It was a very productive training in preparation for physical strength and endurance.
The results during the race was beyond expectations in the sense that I could remain strong and capable of facing harsh conditions.
I am very satisfied with this preparation program and recommend it for any kind of sport.
